title: AI Works While Steven Sleeps
description: Steven describes his goal of having AI assistants like Claude handle his podcast and video work, gives beginners tips for getting started, and talks about NVIDIA's stock jump. He also tries a Beijing noodle dish made with beef tripe and explains why he takes collagen, fish oil and other supplements.

sentences.en: Episode summary

sentences.zh: Сего́дня Сти́вен говори́т о са́мом ва́жном.
sentences.en: Today Steven talks about the most important thing.

sentences.zh: Он хо́чет, что́бы ИИ дела́л его́ рабо́ту.
sentences.en: He wants AI to do his work.
AI means "artificial intelligence", a smart program.

sentences.zh: Ещё Сти́вен рассказывает про акции компании NVIDIA.
sentences.en: Steven also talks about NVIDIA stock.

sentences.zh: И про необычное блюдо из Пекина.
sentences.en: And about an unusual dish from Beijing.

sentences.zh: В конце он отвечает на вопрос своей девушки.
sentences.en: At the end, he answers his girlfriend's question.

sentences.zh: Она спросила: «Зачем ты пьёшь столько витаминов?»
sentences.en: She asked: "Why do you take so many vitamins?"
This episode was noisy.

sentences.zh: У Стивена в духовке жарились стейки.
sentences.en: Steven had steaks cooking in the oven.

sentences.zh: А ещё к нему пришёл сосед.
sentences.en: And a neighbor also came over to see him.
Six months for a big task

sentences.zh: В начале года Стивен сказал родственнику одну вещь.
sentences.en: At the beginning of the year, Steven told a relative one thing.
He gave himself six months.

sentences.zh: Он хотел, чтобы компьютер делал его работу.
sentences.en: He wanted the computer to do his work.
At first, nothing worked.
Steven can't write programs.
He did everything himself.
He was making a page for a website.
He waited for the video to upload.
Every interruption kept him from working.
Then everything changed.
Steven started working with Claude.

sentences.zh: Это помощник, с которым можно говорить.
sentences.en: It's an assistant you can talk to.

sentences.zh: Это было всего два месяца назад.
sentences.en: That was only two months ago.
Steven thinks: "I should have started sooner!"

sentences.zh: Он говорит, что ИИ снова сделал компьютер весёлым.
sentences.en: He says that AI has made the computer fun again.
⏰ The assistants work all night
Steven likes a certain podcast.

sentences.zh: Там говорят так: если ты платишь за помощника и не работаешь с ним, деньги пропадают зря.
sentences.en: They say this there: if you pay for an assistant and don't work with it, the money goes to waste.
Steven pays for a lot of websites.
He spends too much money.

sentences.zh: Он хочет, чтобы помощники работали в интернете.
sentences.en: He wants the assistants to work online.
Then he can turn off the computer.
That's his dream.

sentences.zh: Стивен записывает видео в 6 часов вечера в Пекине.
sentences.en: Steven records videos at 6 p.m. in Beijing.

sentences.zh: В это время в Торонто 5 часов утра.
sentences.en: At that time it's 5 a.m. in Toronto.

sentences.zh: Он хочет, чтобы видео вышло в Торонто в 6 или 7 утра.
sentences.en: He wants the video to come out in Toronto at 6 or 7 a.m.

sentences.zh: Тогда его семья увидит: «Дядя Стивен всё ещё с нами. Он просто далеко».
sentences.en: Then his family will see: "Uncle Steven is still with us. He's just far away."

sentences.zh: Ещё Стивен начал показывать видео в Фейсбуке.
sentences.en: Steven has also started showing his videos on Facebook.
Yesterday he said a bad word.
That's not good!
What if Mom is watching with the grandkids?

sentences.zh: Теперь Стивен будет следить за словами.
sentences.en: From now on Steven will watch his language.
How the podcast is made

sentences.zh: Раньше Стивен делал что-то очень долго.
sentences.en: Steven used to spend a very long time making things.

sentences.zh: Теперь Claude делает это за один день.
sentences.en: Now Claude does it in a single day.
Steven has even made whole websites.
But there is a rule.

sentences.zh: Не показывай никому свои пароли и ключи.
sentences.en: Don't show anyone your passwords and keys.

sentences.zh: Из одного подкаста теперь выходит много всего.
sentences.en: Now a single podcast produces lots of things.

sentences.zh: Это поговорки, примеры из грамматики и короткие видео.
sentences.en: These are sayings, grammar examples and short videos.
Steven checks everything himself.
That's why he works slowly.

sentences.zh: Он говорит, что видео от ИИ пока плохие.
sentences.en: He says that AI videos are still bad for now.
They're unwatchable.

sentences.zh: Картинки со словами получаются так себе.
sentences.en: Pictures with words come out so-so.
Next, Steven wants to find out one thing.

sentences.zh: Как программа Opus Clip режет видео на кусочки?
sentences.en: How does the program Opus Clip cut videos into small pieces?

sentences.en: How to start
Anyone can do this.

sentences.zh: Есть люди, у которых можно учиться на YouTube.
sentences.en: There are people you can learn from on YouTube.

sentences.zh: Это NetworkChuck, Tina Huang и Nate Herk.
sentences.en: They are NetworkChuck, Tina Huang and Nate Herk.

sentences.zh: Есть у тебя идея своего маленького дела?
sentences.en: Do you have an idea for your own small business?
Here's what Steven advises:

sentences.zh: Не ходи один вечер в бар.
sentences.en: Skip going to the bar one evening.
Better on a Thursday, before the bar.
Watch three or four hours of videos.
Then install Claude Code.
Pay for one month.
That's about 30 dollars.
Steven isn't paid for this.

sentences.zh: Если выбрать одно, бери Claude Cowork.
sentences.en: If you pick just one, go with Claude Cowork.

sentences.zh: Спроси его: «Что ты можешь для меня сделать?»
sentences.en: Ask it: "What can you do for me?"
Tell it about your hobbies.
Don't waste time on boring stuff.
You don't need to just sort emails.
Better to make spreadsheets.

sentences.zh: Или пусть он следит за акциями.
sentences.en: Or have it keep track of stocks.

sentences.zh: Стивен просит помощника разобрать видео за 15 лет.
sentences.en: Steven asks the assistant to sort through 15 years of videos.

sentences.zh: Он хочет, чтобы помощник сам выкладывал их в Инстаграм.
sentences.en: He wants the assistant to post them on Instagram by itself.
But what about privacy?

sentences.zh: Да, твои данные идут на чужие компьютеры.
sentences.en: Yes, your data goes to other people's computers.

sentences.zh: Но так же и с почтой Gmail.
sentences.en: But it's the same with Gmail.
Should you make an app?
Yesterday Steven was watching lessons.
Someone there asked: "Should you make an app?"

sentences.zh: Ведь приложение надо чинить всё время.
sentences.en: After all, an app has to be fixed all the time.

sentences.zh: Умные помощники могут следить за ним.
sentences.en: Smart assistants can look after it.

sentences.zh: Пока они делают это не очень хорошо.
sentences.en: For now they don't do it very well.

sentences.zh: Но через год или два они научатся.
sentences.en: But in a year or two they will learn.
Then many people will make apps.

sentences.zh: Ты боишься, что ИИ отнимет работу?
sentences.en: Are you afraid that AI will take away your job?

sentences.zh: Стивен два раза недавно был без работы.
sentences.en: Steven was recently out of work twice.
What did he do?

sentences.zh: Он сел и стал учить ИИ.
sentences.en: He sat down and started teaching AI.
His website has now become better.

sentences.zh: Какой сайт — Стивен пока не скажет.
sentences.en: Which website — Steven won't say yet.
NVIDIA shares soared

sentences.zh: Стивен боялся, что акции NVIDIA упадут.
sentences.en: Steven was afraid that NVIDIA shares would fall.
But they went up!
On Friday the stock cost 125 dollars.
Now it costs 165 dollars.

sentences.zh: Это очень много, почти на треть больше.
sentences.en: That's a lot, almost a third more.
Steven said: "This is just ridiculous!"
In the morning the price had already dropped a little.

sentences.zh: Стивен думает, что она вернётся к 145 долларам.
sentences.en: Steven thinks it will go back to 145 dollars.
But not quite.

sentences.zh: Цена будет стоять рядом с 160–170 долларами.
sentences.en: The price will stay around 160–170 dollars.

sentences.zh: Потом большие деньги решат, куда идти дальше.
sentences.en: Then the big money will decide where to go next.
Steven believes the shares will rise.

sentences.zh: Он шутит: «NVIDIA — не обман. Но все думают, что это просто чипсы Pringles!»
sentences.en: He jokes: "NVIDIA isn't a scam. But everyone thinks it's just Pringles chips!"
This is not financial advice.

sentences.zh: Не говори своему банкиру, что слышал это в подкасте.
sentences.en: Don't tell your banker you heard this on a podcast.

sentences.zh: Помни одно: взять прибыль — всегда хорошо.
sentences.en: Remember one thing: taking profit is always good.
A Beijing dish made from cow
The dish is called "Jingwei baodu fen."
"Jing" means Beijing.
"Wei" means flavor.
"Baodu" is quickly boiled cow stomach.
"Fen" means noodles.
Steven ate a spicy dish.
There was a lot of red pepper in it.
The stomach looks funny.
It's shaggy.
It curls up like squid.

sentences.zh: Но его кладут в лапшу с чесноком, луком и кунжутной пастой.
sentences.en: But they put it in noodles with garlic, green onion and sesame paste.

sentences.zh: Стивен говорит: «Мысль о нём противнее, чем вкус».
sentences.en: Steven says, "The thought of it is more disgusting than the taste."
Collagen and vitamins

sentences.zh: Стивен с девушкой шли на рынок Цайшикоу.
sentences.en: Steven and his girlfriend were walking to Caishikou market.

sentences.zh: Он попросил её помочь найти коллаген.
sentences.en: He asked her to help find collagen.

sentences.zh: Коллаген — это порошок для кожи и суставов.
sentences.en: Collagen is a powder for the skin and joints.
In Chinese it's "jiaoyuan danbai tai."

sentences.zh: В Канаде Стивен платит около 35 долларов за 300 граммов.
sentences.en: In Canada, Steven pays about 35 dollars for 300 grams.

sentences.zh: Он кладёт порошок в утренний кофе.
sentences.en: He puts the powder in his morning coffee.
After the gym, he recovers better.

sentences.zh: В Китае не всегда безопасная еда.
sentences.en: In China, food isn't always safe.
But collagen is easy to find there.

sentences.zh: Есть даже белок из зелёной фасоли.
sentences.en: There's even protein made from mung beans.

sentences.zh: Потом Стивен выложил всё на стол.
sentences.en: Then Steven laid everything out on the table.
There were about 11 jars.

sentences.zh: Это коллаген, рыбий жир, магний, цинк и другое.
sentences.en: There's collagen, fish oil, magnesium, zinc and other things.

sentences.zh: Одну траву он бросил, потому что болел живот.
sentences.en: He quit one herb because it gave him a stomachache.
He doesn't take another herb.

sentences.zh: У него в семье есть больные.
sentences.en: There's illness in his family.
Why did he start?

sentences.zh: Несколько лет назад он понял: в Китае ему, может быть, недолго жить.
sentences.en: A few years ago he realized he might not be able to live in China for long.

sentences.zh: Он думал: «Или Тайвань, Корея, Япония. Или назад в Канаду таскать коробки на складе».
sentences.en: He thought: "Either Taiwan, Korea, Japan. Or back to Canada to haul boxes in a warehouse."
That's when he started his own business.
He started drinking less.
And he decided to help his brain.
He studies Chinese and Russian.
Fish oil helped him think more clearly.
Ashwagandha helped with anxiety.

sentences.zh: Цинк быстро дал сон, через 30 минут.
sentences.en: Zinc put him to sleep fast, within 30 minutes.

sentences.zh: Для начала Стивен советует эти три вещи.
sentences.en: To start, Steven recommends these three things.
But this isn't medical advice.
Ask your doctor!
The main idea

sentences.zh: ИИ, акции, витамины — всегда думай сам.
sentences.en: AI, stocks, vitamins — always think for yourself.

sentences.zh: Пробуй и смотри, что тебе помогает.
sentences.en: Try things and see what helps you.

sentences.zh: А если сомневаешься, возьми деньги и уходи.
sentences.en: And if you're in doubt, take the money and walk away.
